svg.title: FirstRun catches a command that steals a fake cloud key
svg.desc: A person was told a command prints a version. FirstRun decodes the hidden base64, runs it in a sandbox, records it reading a fake AWS key and sending it to a fake internet, and gives the verdict Malicious.

g.text: Fake key found in the request body

svg.text: Caught at the fake internet. 0 bytes left the VM.

g.text: Fake credential from ~/.aws/credentials was sent to updates.acme-cli.test
It was created for this run, and the request never reached the internet.
Verdict from fixed rules, 9.7 s from start to report. Sandbox, network and decoys destroyed.
